'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC male Synchronist found talking to his classmates near the [[Tactical Hologram: Synchronization]] area about seeing clones. 

==Location==


{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Schwartz:'''  I'm telling you, Rabelle College is researching cloning tech!
:'''Trom:''' What? But that's completely against every ethics law on the books!

==Dialogue==
;Day <nowiki>06:00-18:00</nowiki>
:'''Schwartz:'''  I'm telling you, Rabelle College is researching cloning tech!
:'''Trom:''' What? But that's completely against every ethics law on the books!
:'''Schwartz:'''  But I saw it myself! This morning, when I want{{sic}} to deliver the report, I ran into the same guy twice, once in class, and once in the hall!
:'''Trom:''' Maybe he's a space-type Resonator? Or his Forte lets him make clones?
:'''Schwartz:'''  It gets weirder! On my way back to the dorms, I saw "him" a third time!
:'''Kerr:''' Oh, relax. They're just a set of triplets who got in fair and square. Don't make a scene.
:'''Nordstern:''' Wait, could they be...?
:'''Nordstern:''' [[Fratellone]], [[Fratellino]], and [[Fratello]]? Is that them?
:'''Schwartz:'''  No... these guys looked like they were from Huanglong...
{{Dialogue End}}

==Trivia==
* There is two NPC at Huaxu Academy in Jinzhou, both name [[Siqi]] who talks about cloning themself and both having stomachache.
* This could also be a "fourth wall" being broken, referencing NPC's sharing the same appearances. 
* Possible hidden clue pointing to [[Schwarzloch|The Grand Architect]] infiltrating the Academy.
